Adult female bolas spiders (Mastophora hutchinsoni in this videos case) are a group of orb weaver spiders that hunt by making a rope with a glob of sticky goo that they swing at nearby flying insects to snare them. These female spiders also produce a chemical that mimics the mating pheromones of the specific moths they hunt, but they will try to hunt for any nearby insects that fly past them as well.

While the adult females use this interesting hunting method, the males and juveniles hunt usually by ambush, hiding on the edge of leaves and using their front legs to snatch insects as they pass.
